crossRefs.note: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, that is before Egypt.

people.name: Havilah
people.line: Land near Eden with gold, bdellium, and onyx

people.name: Pishon
people.line: A river flowing from Eden, encircling Havilah

translations.web: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
translations.bsb: The name of the first river is the Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
translations.kjv: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
translations.asv: The name of the first is Pishon: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
